summary: You can now hide unmanaged admin accounts you do not care about, and no requested run is lost.

new.title: Ignore unmanaged admin accounts
new.text: On Admin accounts, Ignore hides an unmanaged account for everyone, with an optional reason. Stop ignoring brings it back.

fixes.title: Requested runs are never lost
fixes.text: Two runs queued at the same moment, such as Run now during a change, no longer overwrite each other.

fixes.title: New group memberships no longer fail
fixes.text: Adding a member right after PIM Manager creates a group now shows as waiting and applies on the next run.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The unmanaged accounts box stays closed until a new account appears.
